svg.text: Answer Outcomes on 14 Texas Special-Education Questions, 2025 Pilot and October 2026
Note. Each answer was graded by two AI judges from different companies (Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.5), blind to which system wrote it, against an
expert-reviewed answer key for 14 questions from the 2025 pilot. Bars show raw judge verdicts for every system. October 2026 systems were asked twice,
each question in a new chat (n = 28 answers). "Incomplete" includes answers that declined to answer. Expert review of TXPsyBOT's six single-judge
flags found one confirmed error, two incomplete answers, and three judge errors; public-tool flags were not hand-reviewed. Judges agreed on the
outcome for 82% of answers (Cohen's kappa = .71) and on individual facts for 97% (kappa = .90).
